published_prior_art.cite: Molinari2008 gives general direct-misclassification identified regions; ZhangNieSoonLiu2013 recovers a fixed-margin table at fixed odds ratio, neither gives the shared-channel finite candidate envelope.
CiocaneaTeodorescuGabrielSjolander2025 treats positive-cell probability-of-benefit sensitivity, but no checked result gives the shared-assay closure-to-strict finite attainment criterion.
ZhangNieSoonLiu2013 Section 3.3 supplies the fixed-margin odds-ratio reconstruction; the remaining item is a diagnostic specialization.

GabrielSachsJensen2024 studies bootstrap confidence limits for clean symbolic benefit bounds; KaidoMolinariStoye2019 gives asymptotic calibrated projection, neither supplies exact four-binomial validation projection through this envelope.
KaidoMolinariStoye2019 is generic asymptotic projection inference; the displayed finite-sample modulus is a useful attached consequence of the new envelope, not an independently established frontier.
No checked benefit-bound or direct-misclassification result states a universal lower bound on shared-channel endpoint-evaluation complexity.

novelty_flags.label: related_work / thm:exact-confidence-projection
novelty_flags.one_line: GabrielSachsJensen2024 does not leave boundary-sensitive confidence intervals open: it evaluates bootstrap coverage and reports conservative m-out-of-n correction near boundaries.

soundness_flags.label: def:closed-model; q0 and q1; all population theorems
soundness_flags.one_line: The model permits P(A=a)=0 although q_a=P(W=1|A=a) is used throughout; add positive assignment probabilities to the formal model.

soundness_flags.label: ass:primitive-count-independence
soundness_flags.one_line: The stated Bonferroni containment and marginal Hoeffding/Clopper--Pearson arguments do not require mutual independence, so this load-bearing dependency should be dropped or tied to a genuinely joint calculation.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: ass:validation-transport / thm:exact-confidence-projection
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: Sensitivity and specificity are assumed transportable from the blinded gold-standard validation population to the trial channel.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: The exact projection and width claims are conditional on point transport of the common assay channel; blinding alone does not establish it.

source_verification_receipts.version: author manuscript of the 2013 JRSS C article
source_verification_receipts.locator: Section 3.3, especially pp. 696--697 / equations (6) and the table-recovery display
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: For a fixed positive odds ratio and fixed binary margins, the paper determines one table cell and reconstructs the remaining cells; it does not optimize over uncertain assay channels.
Direct misclassification is represented by a linear simultaneous system involving a misclassification-probability matrix, with identified-region estimation and confidence-set construction.

The article studies probability of benefit in a binary randomized trial through a dependence sensitivity parameter and identifies the target at fixed parameter values under stated positivity conditions.

The paper computes bootstrap confidence limits for benefit bounds, finds regular-bootstrap undercoverage near a boundary, and reports conservative m-out-of-n remedies; it does not describe boundary-aware confidence intervals as an open problem.
The paper estimates sharp bounds on the distribution of treatment effects and establishes asymptotic distributions, while discussing bootstrap failure.
The paper proposes bootstrap calibrated projection with uniform asymptotic coverage for components and smooth functions in moment-(in)equality models.
Transporting sensitivity and specificity from external validation data requires substantive transportability conditions and rich validation information; it is not implied by blinding.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Add a formal assignment-positivity assumption, include it in both model definitions, and state explicitly that all q_a and sampling claims are conditional on this design condition.

Replace the GabrielSachsJensen2024 “open” comparison with the accurate bootstrap-boundary result, then state precisely that the new gap is exact simultaneous validation-binomial projection and the finite four-region evaluator.

Make the finite-envelope theorem the paper headline and add a direct computational comparison against generic nonlinear optimization on a nondegenerate family, including the certified edge-minimum example.

recommended_next_step: Repair assignment positivity and the Gabriel comparison, remove or justify count independence, then advance the shared-channel envelope as a field-tier PartialID kernel.
